name: manual_8560a9
claim: G7 async notifications in orama-system must remain a v1 portal MVP: preserve versioned SSE envelope fields for future v2.1 GossipMesh adapters, but do not implement mesh replication, durable replay, or v2.5 safety overlays in the G7 MVP branch.

decisions.notes: The G7 MVP branch now documents and tests the adapter seam against docs/v2 without expanding scope. This prevents future agents from silently turning a local portal notification scaffold into a mesh/safety platform rewrite.
